lines.text: Jesus sees a man blind from birth and says neither the man nor his parents sinned.
Jesus makes mud, puts it on the man's eyes, and sends him to wash in the Pool of Bethesda.
His parents confirm he is their son, born blind, but fear the Jews, who would expel anyone confessing Christ.
The ones who insult the man say they are disciples of Abraham, and that God spoke to Abraham.
They throw the man out, then Jesus finds him, and the man says, "Lord, I believe," and worships Him.
